verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a connection pooler such as Supavisor or PgBouncer, nor any capacity for thousands of concurrent connections. The connecting-to-Postgres doc only says there are several ways to connect from frontend, backend or serverless code, and read replicas are load balancing rather than connection pooling. Connection pooling is a fair axis for a hosted Postgres platform, so the lack of evidence makes this none.
